content.short: ZiberBugs is a Cardano Web3 1v1 autobattler with collectible bug characters and competitive matches.
content.description: ZiberBugs is a Web3 1v1 autobattler built for competitive players and NFT game communities. Inspired by tactical battler formats, the project focuses on quick strategic matches, collectible bug characters, and a game economy designed around digital ownership. Its documentation outlines the game, organization, and project finances, while the product itself aims to make competitive play fun and accessible. ZiberBugs fits the Cardano NFT gaming niche through its mix of collectibles and player-versus-player gameplay.
